title: ServiceSuitability
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — Suitability viability dimension. Degree to which an IT service provides functions that meet stated and implied needs when the service is used under specified conditions. Sub-characteristics: Completeness, Correctness, Appropriateness, Consistency. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying service suitability state. Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.1.

completeness.description: Degree to which the IT service provides all functions stated or implied by service agreements. PARTIAL = some functions missing. SUBSTANTIAL = most functions provided. FULL = all agreed functions delivered.

correctness.description: Degree to which the IT service provides correct results with the agreed degree of precision.

appropriateness.description: Degree to which the functions of the IT service facilitate the accomplishment of specified tasks and objectives.

consistency.description: Degree to which the IT service behavior and information is consistent across service delivery channels.
